hooks.command: jq -n --arg ctx "$(date '+%A, %B %-d, %Y at %-I:%M %p %Z (UTC%z)')" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:("Current local date and time: " + $ctx + ". This is refreshed on every message; use it as your reference for \"now\" and \"today\".")}}'

jq -n --arg ctx "$(hostname)" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:("Hostname: " + $ctx + ". This is refreshed on every message; use it as your reference for which machine you are currently running on.")}}'
